verdict.rationale: LiteLLM exposes a well-documented, OpenAI-compatible API/SDK (completion() interface, proxy endpoints, virtual keys, MCP gateway) explicitly designed for programmatic/agentic use, with extensive public docs and llms.txt support confirmed by probes. Community evidence (Show HN threads) corroborates real-world API-driven usage, though reliability/security controversies are a caveat rather than a contradiction of API existence.
